name: Bockhorn (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bockhorn (a leaping red stag above a blue hunting horn on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Bockhorn; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bockhorn arms — stag and horn on yellow
